title: Epic: Add locale-based i18n with German translation
description: Add first-class internationalization to the Next.js App Router site so English and German are both fully supported with localized routes, metadata, and structured data. Success means every customer-facing string is sourced from translation dictionaries, /en and /de routes render equivalent content, and SEO artifacts (sitemap/canonical/alternate links/schema text) are locale-aware. Keep implementation dependency-light and compatible with the current architecture.

title: Set up locale routing and detection middleware
description:
## Files
- middleware.ts (create)
- lib/i18n/config.ts (create)
- lib/i18n/locale.ts (create)

## What to do
Define supported locales as exactly `en` and `de`, with `en` as default. Add middleware that redirects any non-static, non-API route without a locale prefix to `/{defaultLocale}` + original path/query. Preserve already-prefixed routes (`/en/*`, `/de/*`) and skip Next internals/assets (`/_next`, files with extensions, `favicon.ico`, images). Add reusable helpers to parse locale from pathname and to validate locale values.

## Don't
- Don't add third-party i18n packages in this task
- Don't modify page/component copy yet
- Don't hardcode locale logic outside `lib/i18n/*` helpers
acceptance_criteria:
- `middleware.ts` redirects `/` to `/en` and `/rooms` to `/en/rooms` while preserving query params
- Requests to `/de`, `/de/rooms`, and `/en/contact` are not redirected
- Requests to `/_next/*` and static assets are not redirected
- `lib/i18n/config.ts` exposes a typed source of truth for locales used by middleware and future tasks
close_reason: 06357c8 feat: set up locale routing and detection middleware

Convert schema exports into locale-capable builders (or locale-specific constants) so descriptive text can render in English/German while preserving factual fields. title: Create locale-segment app shell and dictionary loader
description:

## What to do
Introduce a locale-segment shell for App Router routes under `app/[locale]/...`. Build a typed `Dictionary` contract and server-side loader function signature `getDictionary(locale)` that will return locale content in later tasks. In `app/[locale]/layout.tsx`, validate locale params and call `notFound()` for unsupported locales. Keep layout behavior equivalent to existing `app/layout.tsx` (nav, footer, scripts, fonts) while preparing for injected translated strings via props.

- Don't add real translation text values yet
- Don't move SEO metadata generation yet

- Visiting `/en` and `/de` renders through `app/[locale]/layout.tsx`
- Unsupported locale paths like `/fr` return 404 via `notFound()`
- `getDictionary(locale)` exists with typed return contract and compile-time locale safety
- Existing global scripts/fonts/nav/footer behavior remains intact for locale routes
close_reason: 637dbc7 Create locale-segment app shell and dictionary loader

title: Define complete English dictionary schema and source all copy keys
description:
## Files
- lib/i18n/dictionaries/en.ts (create)
- lib/i18n/dictionaries/types.ts (modify)
- docs/i18n-copy-map.md (create)

## What to do
Create a complete English dictionary object that covers every user-facing string currently hardcoded in app pages/components (nav labels, CTA/button text, section headings, paragraph copy, metadata text, alt/title attributes, and price-note labels). Expand `Dictionary` types so missing keys fail TypeScript checks. Add a concise copy map doc listing key namespaces and where they are consumed, to keep future translations deterministic.

## Don't
- Don't translate to German here
- Don't leave fallback `as any` or optional keys for required copy
- Don't modify page/component rendering logic beyond key wiring needs
acceptance_criteria:
- `en.ts` contains values for all required dictionary keys with no TODO placeholders
- `types.ts` enforces required keys such that removing a key from `en.ts` causes a type error
- `docs/i18n-copy-map.md` maps dictionary namespaces to concrete page/component consumers
- No hardcoded user-facing English remains in files touched by this task except brand names/proper nouns
close_reason: 43ddb20 define complete English dictionary schema and source all copy keys
